items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-04-02
items.q: the first song I played with her was, Walt Tilly, Won't You Take Your Time

ctx.x: She is powerful, as loud as...

Yeah, but down there she just didn't have enough of pep in her, you know. Not as much pep in her. Pep, you see, when you're first singing or something, you got to sing with a feeling or something, you know. If you make the house shake, well you're doing something. I know, I started doing that in New York. You know what I'm saying? And you see, when I worked with Bessie, I tell you the first song, Bessie, I don't say the first song, but the first song I played with her was, Walt Tilly, Won't You Take Your Time.…
Did you ever work on a show with her?
